title: Law to limit weight and backpack rules for grocery delivery workers
summary: This bill would stop third-party grocery delivery services from requiring delivery workers to carry more than 22 pounds of goods in a single trip. It would also bar these services from requiring workers to wear backpacks when delivering by bicycle, scooter or moped, and would prohibit retaliation against workers who exercise these rights. Violations could bring civil penalties and worker remedies, and the law would take effect 90 days after becoming law, applying only to agreements made afterward.
